description: The file contains test cases for decoding different types of GatewayFrame structures from JSON data, verifying the correct parsing of various frame formats including event, request, and unknown frames. It uses the XCTest framework for testing the decoding logic in a Swift project.

methods.name: `decodes event frame with any codable payload`
methods.description: Test for decoding an event frame with a payload containing codable data, verifying the frame type, payload contents, and sequence number.

methods.name: `decodes request frame with nested params`
methods.description: Test for decoding a request frame with nested parameters, verifying payload contents, nested item arrays, and metadata.

methods.name: `decodes unknown frame and preserves raw`
methods.description: Test for decoding a frame with an unrecognized type, ensuring the raw JSON is preserved and frame type is marked as unknown.
